seo.ip: Look up an IPv4 or IPv6 address to see its approximate location, network provider, reputation, and routing details.
seo.whois: Look up public registration records for a domain, IP address, or autonomous system number with WHOIS and RDAP.
seo.status: Check service status and reported incidents for cloud platforms, AI services, developer tools, and communities.
seo.ping: Measure latency from global probes to a hostname or IP address and compare results by location.
seo.speedtest: Measure download speed, upload speed, latency, and jitter from your browser.
seo.leak.dns: Identify the DNS resolvers your browser uses and check whether they match your expected network exit.
seo.leak.webrtc: Inspect the IP addresses your browser exposes through WebRTC and compare them with your network exit.
seo.unlock.sites: Check which websites you can reach and compare latency and network exits from your browser.
seo.unlock.gpt: Check your connection to ChatGPT and inspect the network exit used to reach it.
seo.unlock.claude: Check your connection to Claude and review the network and browser signals relevant to access.
seo.browser.environment: Inspect your browser environment, including its reported platform, language, time zone, and display properties.
seo.browser.fingerprint: See the browser and device signals that websites can use for fingerprinting.
seo.browser.checks: Compare browser signals and check for inconsistencies in the reported environment.
seo.browser.privacy: Review browser privacy signals and see what information websites can access.
seo.terms: Read the terms for using One IP and its IP lookup and network diagnostics tools.
seo.privacy: Learn how One IP handles information when you use its IP lookup and network diagnostics tools.
seo.dns-records: Compare DNS records from Cloudflare and Google.
seo.about: About One IP, its network diagnostic tools, data sources and contact details.
about.intro: One IP is an open-source toolbox for IP lookups, network diagnostics, browser checks and service status.
about.results: Results depend on your browser, network and third-party services and may vary by time, location and data source.
